packet_provenance.supersession_reason: V2 binds current authority epoch 9.13 and corrects PostTool receipt-construction source from RUNTIME_RECEIPT to ENFORCEMENT_CODE/source-only evidence.

source_crosschecks.claim: zulassen() records capability/generation/precondition/idempotency status and updates one session-scoped active_turns.effect_id, but the path is explicitly fail-silent/nonblocking; rejected, duplicate and unchecked outcomes do not prevent the ordinary tool from proceeding. PostTool code constructs bounded result hashes rather than proving arbitrary external-world effects.

_beleg_pruefen rejects an effect proof only when status equals legacy lowercase 'fehler' and accepts a textual test proof when its supplied exit-code string equals '0'; reconcile promotes any ok proof to stand='fertig'.
PreToolUse and PostToolUse both route through the single stern.py dispatcher; hooks.json itself does not establish runtime serialization, invocation correlation correctness or containment.

semantic_atoms.what_it_does: Donor EffectGate is admission/idempotency/result bookkeeping without deterministic pre-side-effect blocking authority.
semantic_atoms.failure_mode: A denied/duplicate/unchecked bookkeeping status can coexist with the tool actually executing.

semantic_atoms.what_it_does: PreToolUse writes the current effect_id into one active_turns slot keyed by session_id and PostToolUse later consumes that current slot.
semantic_atoms.failure_mode: Potential cross-wire when same-session state-changing calls interleave; actual reachability remains unproven until scheduler tracing.
semantic_atoms.counterhypothesis: Exact installed scheduler could serialize the relevant call triplets.

semantic_atoms.what_it_does: Completion effect evidence fails only on exact legacy lowercase status 'fehler'.
semantic_atoms.failure_mode: Current non-success states can structurally satisfy completion proof.

semantic_atoms.what_it_does: Text test:<exit_code>:<description> is accepted when the supplied exit-code string is 0 without immutable execution identity.
semantic_atoms.failure_mode: Forged/transplanted textual claims can satisfy completion.

semantic_atoms.what_it_does: Constructs file-byte or stdout/stderr/exit-code digests for bounded tool-result evidence.
semantic_atoms.failure_mode: Source code or successful tool return can be over-promoted into observed runtime/world-effect verification.

frankenstein_2_architecture_changes.acceptance: Adversarial same-session A/B interleaving must not cross-wire effect identity; stale/wrong invocation IDs fail closed.

frankenstein_2_architecture_changes.change: Separate admission bookkeeping from actual pre-side-effect enforcement. Prevention credit requires a deterministic allow/deny decision consumed before mutation plus a bound decision receipt.
frankenstein_2_architecture_changes.acceptance: DENY must prove non-execution for every admitted mutating class; bookkeeping-only paths receive zero containment credit.

frankenstein_2_architecture_changes.change: Replace legacy permissive completion proof with an explicit structured success-state allowlist and immutable receipt binding.

frankenstein_2_architecture_changes.acceptance: WorldSlice similarity/inference cannot mint truth; Xeno writer capability cannot imply effect authority; simulated outcomes cannot satisfy completion evidence.
